part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Only the within-layer chain must run in order (SAE training waits on that layer's activations), but SAEs for different layers are mutually independent and would run concurrently on separate GPUs","reason":"Changes the measurement to feature-level non-identifiability, but only independent per-layer SAEs run side by side; the serial within-layer chain remains."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Attribution must precede steering, but the per-feature steering measurements are fully independent and could be batched/vectorized across the dictionary","reason":"New intervention-based measurement, but parallelism is only batching independent steering runs; the train-SAE-attribution-steering chain stays sequential."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"The M gradient samples are mutually independent and only the active-variable MCMC must run serially","reason":"Reparameterization shortens the serial chain but its iterations still run one after another; parallel gradient samples are independent copies."}]}
